timing_unit.bench_static: Repeated complete frame construction + reset, no event dispatch. Setup outside samples.
timing_unit.bench_analysis: Fresh inference with scope/effect projection and annotated TUI IR. Separate from key-to-frame target.
timing_unit.bench_ansi: Repeated complete ANSI frame rendering + reset, no event dispatch. Setup outside samples.

method: Same ReleaseFast executable; one runtime flag disables a single mechanism. AB and BA blocks alternate, no samples discarded. Each internal sample includes final frame/output-reset/paired-clock boundary; analysis-only and ANSI-only probes explicitly differ. Baseline contains restored unused Node fields to isolate traversal. This is an ablation benchmark, not chronological historical measurement.

cell_interning.mechanism: Identical cells share immutable JSON cell maps. Empty 80x24 frame, repeated full frame snapshot.

cell_array_reservation.mechanism: Reserve the known cell count rather than repeatedly grow the cell-value array.

frame_allocation_lifetime.mechanism: Before retains temporary layout plus output in session storage. After uses scratch and caller-owned resettable output. Both include output reset and paired clock reads.
